business_summary: Laxmi India Finance Limited, a non-banking finance company, provides financial products and services to individuals, businesses, and institutions in India. It offers MSME, wholesale, business, personal, term, and residential construction loans, and other credit solutions, as well as vehicle loans including two-wheeler, tractors, used cars, commercial vehicles, and electric vehicle loans. The company was formerly known as Laxmi India Finance Private Limited and changed its name to Laxmi India Finance Limited in October 2024. Laxmi India Finance Limited was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Jaipur, India.
